decision: Scaffold SPEC 001 on branch dd/scaffold
why: Boyd asked for this branch and a draft pull request

decision: Run TypeScript with node --experimental-strip-types
why: SPEC says pick strip-types or tsc and add no other build tool

decision: A new pick rests in intake until the scouting report is recorded
why: A1 prints status intake, and there is no event between create and the report

decision: scouting is an alias of intake inside next()
why: The glossary names both, and only intake is event-sourced before the report

decision: Exactly one finished candidate skips Film Room and Trade
why: ARCHITECTURE 3.3 calls that a walkover; zero finished fails the pick

decision: Second judge pass when the top two weighted means are within 10 percent
why: A8; weighted mean is sum(score*weight)/sum(weight)

decision: Disagreeing passes use fewer risks, then fewer commands, then lower cand id
why: Arena tie rule needs a deterministic smaller-and-cleaner pick

decision: Same event type plus key is a no-op
why: A revival that fires twice must not double-launch

decision: The War Room appends inbox rows and never writes pick events
why: A11; dd intake --from-inbox is the only pick writer

decision: Hard caps live in code: N 5, one relaunch, two fix loops, two judge passes
why: A10; config cannot raise them

decision: npm test, tsc --noEmit, and selftest are green; War Room New pick and the drafted pick page were driven in a browser
why: SPEC 001 VERIFY steps

decision: Each entry replays reduce() on the prefix at that entry's effective time and the sentence names the stage change
why: The decision log has to stay in agreement with the reducer, which is the only status source

decision: A run opens only when the replayed pick's runs count increases
why: counts.total has to equal reduce().runs, and that count is the run-opening events

decision: Effective time is the previous time when a timestamp is earlier or will not parse
why: Durations are differences of those times, so none go negative

decision: Agent links are emitted only for a bc- uuid; other ids stay text
why: Selftest ids and hostile payloads must not become links

decision: The Decision log is built with createTextNode on a 390 px layout
why: Payload text can contain markup and has to stay literal on a phone

decision: Base the Pick 2 graft on dd/p2-timeline-c, the snapshot story
why: Film Room pass 1 was a single-pass close call and ranked c3 first; run openings stay derived from reduce().runs

decision: An unknown or missing physical verdict closes the run as inconclusive
why: The pairing table only names verified, not_verified, and inconclusive for physical and fix

decision: A judgement with no pass names the cand from the closed judge run
why: T5(c) closes the earliest open judge, and that run's pass still resolves the base label

decision: The title switch ends in a never default
why: Adding an EVENT_TYPES member must fail tsc, while a string outside the list still titles as Unrecognized event

decision: The Decision log takes app.js el instead of declaring its own
why: Two global function el declarations would shadow each other

decision: Rejected the run-bar strip, the RULES registry, and the first-report timeout
why: Those are a feature, an architecture swap, or a second timeout derivation; openings stay on reduce().runs
